title: Ransomware after 6-hour dwell time
narrative: Same encryption event as Scenario A. Forensics show the attacker had persistent access from 03:00 UTC. Any recovery point taken after 03:00 may contain attacker persistence, so it cannot be trusted. Recovery must use points from before the cutoff.

injections.description: Ransomware encrypted six production systems after a six-hour dwell period.

recommended_actions: Restore only from points before 03:00 UTC
Hunt for persistence before reconnecting systems
